blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) on Tuesday warned that government laptops newly issued to teachers will not be operational once they are sold or pawned to others. According to Education Secretary Sonny Angara, the agency has set strict safeguards to ensure that the laptops will be protected against illegal acts or other misuse. This came after the government began the nationwide distribution of over 231,000 laptops for public school teachers and administrative officers.
